Compare Two Quantile Tables Side by Side

Source: R/custom_functions.r
fx.compare.two.quantile.tables.sidebyside.Rd

Creates a two_column, side_by_side HTML layout showing compact DT tables for two selected Hydra/FlomQ quantile scenarios. Each table is formatted with fixed digits, optional special_column precision, and wrapped in a coloured container for visual comparison.

Usage

fx.compare.two.quantile.tables.sidebyside(
  scenarioA,
  scenarioB,
  scenarios.df,
  results,
  special_col = "Relative",
  fontsize = 12,
  bgA = "#eef6ff",
  bgB = "#ffeff5"
)

Arguments

scenarioA

Character. Name of the first scenario to display. Must correspond to a name in results.

scenarioB

Character. Name of the second scenario to display.

scenarios.df

Optional data frame describing scenarios (not used internally but kept for API symmetry).

results

A named list where each element contains a $table data frame with quantile results.

special_col

Character. Column name that should receive special_digits formatting. Default is "Relative".

fontsize

Numeric. Base font size passed to fx.compact_dt().

bgA

Character. Background colour for scenario A container.

bgB

Character. Background colour for scenario B container.

Value

An HTML widget (via htmltools::browsable) showing the two formatted tables side by side.

Details

The function:

  • formats numeric columns using fixed digits

  • applies special precision to one column (e.g., "Relative")

  • builds compact DT widgets using fx.compact_dt()

  • arranges them in a responsive two_column grid
